title: Add Compose Graphql Schema Build Command
description: compose/graphql: Add a build command that takes the schema from compose/rs and overwrites the schema.graphql file.
summary: Added a compose/graphql build target that regenerates schema.graphql from the compose/rs async-graphql schema. Exposed a Rust schema_sdl helper plus an ignored exporter test for the build command, added a sync test that verifies the checked-in schema matches compose/rs, regenerated schema.graphql, and aligned the existing engine schema validation with the Rust-generated GraphQL surface. Verified npx nx build compose/graphql, npm --workspace @semio-tech/compose-engine test, and cargo test --manifest-path compose/rs/Cargo.toml.
